in_hebrew.name: מלאכיה
in_hebrew.meaning: מלאך אלוהים, שליח אלוהים, קול אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מלאכיה הוא שם שפירושו 'מלאך אלוהים' או 'שליח אלוהים'. הוא מורכב משתי מילים עבריות: 'מלאך' (מלאך) שפירושו מלאך או שליח, ו'אלוהים' (אלוהים) שפירושו אלוהים. השם מלאכיה מופיע במקרא ככותרת לספר הנבואה של מלאכי, הנביא האחרון של התנ'ך העברי. הנביא מלאכי היה שליח אלוהים ששלח לקראת סוף תקופת בית שני כדי להזהיר את עם ישראל מפני חטאיהם ולקרוא לתשובה.

in_greek.name: Μαλαχίας
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Μαλαχίας είναι όνομα που σημαίνει 'αγγελος θεου' (αγγελος θεου) ή 'μηνυτης θεου' (μηνυτης θεου). Προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'αγγελος' (αγγελος) που σημαίνει αγγελος ή μήνυμα και 'θεου' (θεου) που σημαίνει Θεός. Το όνομα Μαλαχίας εμφανίζεται στην Καινή Διαθήκη ως ο τίτλος του βιβλίου του προφήτη Μαλαχία, ο οποίος ήταν ο τελευταίος προφήτης της Παλαιάς Διαθήκης. Ο προφήτης Μαλαχίας ήταν ένας αγγελος του Θεού που στάλθηκε λίγο πριν το τέλος της περιόδου του Β' Ναού για να προειδοποιήσει τον λαό του Ισραήλ για τις αμαρτίες τους και να καλέσει σε μετάνοια.

in_latin.name: Malachias
in_latin.meaning: angel of God, messenger of God
in_latin.long_meaning: Malachias is a name that means 'angel of God' or 'messenger of God'. It is derived from the Hebrew words 'mal'ak' (מלאך) meaning angel or messenger and 'El' (אל) meaning God. The name Malachias appears in the Bible as the title of the book of the prophet Malachi, who was the last prophet of the Old Testament. The prophet Malachi was a messenger of God who was sent to warn the people of Israel of their sins and to call them to repentance.

in_english.name: Malakiah
in_english.meaning: angel of God, messenger of God, my messenger
in_english.long_meaning: Malakiah is a Christian name that originated from the Hebrew name 'Mal'akhi' (מלאכי), meaning 'my messenger' or 'angel of God'. The name is derived from the Hebrew words 'mal'ak' (מלאך) meaning angel or messenger and 'hi' (י) meaning my. In the Bible, Malachi was the last prophet of the Old Testament, who was a messenger of God sent to warn the people of Israel of their sins and to call them to repentance. The name Malakiah has been used in Christian tradition to signify a person who is a messenger of God's love and truth. It connotes qualities of spirituality, communication, and divine guidance.

biblical_reference.note: The book of Malachi is the last book of the Old Testament and contains the prophecies of Malachi, who was a messenger of God sent to Israel.

data.cultural_impact: The name Malakiah, derived from the Hebrew language, holds a rich cultural significance as it carries the meaning of "God's messenger" or "angel." Throughout history and across Christian denominations, angels have been revered as divine beings who serve as intermediaries between God and humanity. Malakiah, as a name, is a testament to the belief in the importance of divine intervention and the belief in the existence of spiritual beings who carry out God's will.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Malakiah holds deep spiritual significance as it emphasizes the concept of divine communication and intervention. Christians view angels as spiritual beings who carry out God's will and who serve as messengers between God and His people. The name Malakiah, therefore, serves as a reminder of the belief in the existence of a loving and all-powerful God who is active in the world and who cares for His people. Additionally, the name Malakiah may be a source of comfort and encouragement for those who believe in the protection and guidance of angels.

historical_references.reference: The Old Testament prophet Malachi is the last of the twelve minor prophets. His name means 'my messenger' in Hebrew.
historical_references.context: Malachi's prophecies were delivered to the people of Judah around the time of Nehemiah's second governorship (Nehemiah 12:24).

historical_references.reference: In the New Testament, Malachi is mentioned in Malachi 4:5-6 by Jesus as a forerunner to John the Baptist.
historical_references.context: Jesus speaks of Malachi's prophecy as already being fulfilled in the appearance and ministry of John the Baptist (Luke 1:17).

It is often used as a name for babies in religious communities and can be seen on various platforms such as social media, baby name websites, and religious communities. Some parents may choose this name due to its spiritual implications, while others may simply find it to be a beautiful and unique name for their child.

name_in_real_life.story: Ruth Malakiah from Rome, Italy embodies the meaning of Malakiah - "My messenger". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Malakiah means "my messenger" in Hebrew, symbolizing God's divine presence and guidance through His angels or messengers. It highlights the belief in God's constant communication and care for His people.
